question: Where are a beach resort within 60 kilometers of Children's Cultural Center of Native America, New York, NY in the south direction?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p WHERE p.poi_name ILIKE '%resort%' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Children''s Cultural Center of Native America%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 60000 ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Children''s Cultural Center of Native America%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5;
